title: Gemini: what to know
description: The essentials of Gemini in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Gemini: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: May 21 - Jun 20. Air element, mutable quality, ruled by Mercury.

pages.title: Curiosity
pages.text: Gemini learns fast, adapts and talks to anyone. There is always a new idea.

pages.title: Scattered focus
pages.text: Interests that change quickly can leave projects half done. Picking one priority helps.

pages.title: Talk and lightness
pages.text: Falls for the mind. Good conversation and humor beat big promises.

pages.title: The one who communicates
pages.text: Does well where ideas flow: writing, teaching, sales and anything that changes often.
